::: entry
**[EqualPayForEqualWork](https://github.com/tejeramaxwell/EqualPayForEqualWork)** [2023 – Present]{.date}\
[Master's thesis, University of Colorado Denver. Jupyter Notebook.]{.place}

Uses CPS microdata to show that pay transparency laws contributed to Colorado leading the nation in reducing the gender wage gap. Related: [factsheet](https://www.wfco.org/equalpay), [Colorado Sun coverage](https://coloradosun.com/2024/03/16/colorado-women-gender-pay-gap-men-parity-equity/), [Substack summary](https://maxtejera.substack.com/p/colorados-pay-transparency-law-closing).

:::
